name: AutoHotkey Linter
description: AST/regex-hybrid linter for AutoHotkey v2 migration: detects legacy v1 syntax patterns (command-style calls, %var% deref, Gosub, deprecated directives), auto-fixes common cases, and reports SARIF/JSON for CI. Exposes an MCP server so agents can lint and pre-flight-check LLM-generated AHK code before executing it.
author: Sandra Schipal

tools.name: lint_ahk_script
tools.description: Lint an AutoHotkey v2 script (given as source text) and return diagnostics: v1 syntax patterns, safety issues, style problems, and dead code. Use before executing any AHK script generated by an LLM.

source.description: Complete AHK source code to lint

tools.name: lint_ahk_file
tools.description: Lint an AHK file already on disk and return the same diagnostics shape as lint_ahk_script (issues list, total count, severity breakdown).

tools.name: fix_ahk_script
tools.description: Auto-fix common v1-to-v2 issues in an AHK script: Random, StringSplit, IfEqual, FileRead, FormatTime, %var% dereference, Menu/Tray, and similar mechanical patterns. Returns the fixed source and what was changed.

source.description: Complete AHK source code to fix

tools.name: lint_check
tools.description: Quick pass/fail pre-flight check: is this AHK script clean (no errors)? Use before executing LLM-generated AHK code when you just need a boolean decision plus the first error, not the full diagnostics list.

source.description: Complete AHK source code to check

tools.name: list_checks
tools.description: List every available lint check with its rule ID, severity, and description (v1 syntax, safety, style, dead code, and function-rename rule modules).
